description:
This modification is to upated the NSNs on this project.  There are now 43 NSNs.  A revised market research spreadsheet is being included with the revised NSNs/quantities. 

__________________________

This acquisition is for supplies for which the Government does not possess complete unrestrictive technical data. This is a sources sought notice required when using only approved sources under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1).

SEE ATTACHMENTS: MARKET QUESTIONAIRRE AND MARKET RESEARCH SPREADSHEET WITH NSN INFO.  Return directly to Brandy.Warner@dla.mil. 

NO DATA IS AVAILABLE. AN ALTERNATE OFFEROR IS REQUIRED TO PROVIDE A COMPLETE DATA PACKAGE INCLUDING DATA FOR THE APPROVED AND ALTERNATE PART FOR EVALUATION.

DLA Land and Maritime is considering a future solicitation(s), and subsequent award, of an Indefinite Quantity Contract (IQC/LTC) for the item(s) on the market research spreadsheet. The resultant IQC/LTC could potentially range from 3 to 5 years in length.
Please provide any adddtional sources that may be able to manufacture these items.
